failure.message: Checkpoint assertion failed: "the results heading shows the text <s>mug</s> literally, with the angle brackets visible"
failure.title: Search heading renders query markup as HTML
failure.rootCause: The page treated the submitted text `<s>mug</s>` as HTML. As a result, the angle brackets disappeared and “mug” was displayed with a line through it rather than as literal text.
failure.suggestedFix: Escape search-query text before placing it in the results heading, then add a regression test for HTML-like queries such as `<s>mug</s>`.
